Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Daii Reshan: 41-year-old woman, 165 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: long narrow face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; broad low bridge, full lips; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: wrapped contrasting band. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: one bounded geometric forearm tattoo; a shallow cheek scar; contrasting boot laces. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: deliberately tousled but clean. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a wooden thread gauge only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
